claims.disproof_condition: 條件：古河的決算簡報、質疑應答錄或年報寫出 HVLP／高周波回路箔的需要減速、降價、稼動率下滑或高付加價值品比率回落，或銅箔事業的上修被撤回。核查頻率：每季（古河決算簡報與質疑應答錄）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 的 claim 降信心，重讀 HVLP 銅箔層（mat:hvlp_copper_foil）的供給側。
claims.statement: Furukawa Electric's 2026-06-04 information-components business briefing says its copper foil business has shifted its product portfolio toward AI servers, that HVLP copper foil sales have grown since fiscal 2023 on AI server demand, and that it is meeting expected high demand for HVLP4-class foil with its F0X-WS foil to support AI server boards worldwide. These are the company's own statements; the deck names no customers and gives no HVLP volumes or market share.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：古河的決算或事業說明會寫出 DC 內 DFB 需要減速、降價、DFB 增產效果下修，或岩手前工程新廠（2028 年 4 月量產）延後或縮減。核查頻率：每季（古河決算簡報與質疑應答錄）。觸發後 48 小時：e2 的 claim 降信心，重讀 CW DFB 雷射層（tech:cw_dfb_laser）的供給側。
claims.statement: The same briefing lists DFB laser chips and external light sources (ELS) among Furukawa's intra-data-center products, citing rising light-source demand from 400G/800G, says it is developing and expanding sales of high-power DFB/ELS for 800G/1.6T with expanding adoption in next-generation CPO architectures, says intra-data-center DFB laser chip demand is expanding, and states that demand for high-power DFB laser chips as external light sources is expanding rapidly. It lays out a ¥38 billion capacity investment announced in December 2025, including a new front-end wafer fab at Iwate with mass production scheduled for April 2028, targeting a tenfold profit increase by fiscal 2030 versus fiscal 2025. The deck names no customers and gives no DFB volumes or share.
